verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a workflow automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk or batch capability, such as batch actions, multi-item processing steps or bulk API endpoints. Custom Node.js/Python code and the REST API are developer building blocks a user could use to build bulk handling, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
